newsitem.title: UK: NZ SPORT - Richie Blackmore linked with Leeds.
newsitem.headline: NZ SPORT - Richie Blackmore linked with Leeds.

text.p: LONDON, Oct 31 - Leeds have emerged as favourites to secure the signature of Kiwis rugby league centre Richie Blackmore, NZPA reported on Friday (NZT).

The 27-year-old, who starts tomorrow's third test against Great Britain on the interchange bench, has been the centre of intense speculation in Britain since indicating he wanted to cut short his contract with the Auckland Warriors.
His old club Castleford and Super League champions St Helens were both favoured in the scramble for his signature, but now Leeds appear to have the inside running.
St Helens pulled out of the contest today, saying negotiations were taking too long.
Chief executive David Howes said: "We made a massive offer to Richie but we do not have time to wait. We have other players we wish to pursue."
Blackmore was spoken to by Leeds' new chief executive Gary Hetherington before he left the Great Britain tour party in New Zealand last week.
Hetherington was this week confirmed as moving to Leeds from Yorkshire rivals Sheffield.
His presence on the Lions tour was seen as crucial to securing Blackmore, who still has a cult following in the British game.
Reports here today said that Blackmore, who has an English wife, is to have further talks with Hetherington after tomorrow's third test.
Leeds had a disappointing first Super League season, dropping from title contenders to relegation candidates.
Coach Dean Bell wants to rebuild his squad, and has Hetherington's backing to do it.
